# INTERVAL values are supported only where the emulator implements them; anything else, such as
# arithmetic, comparisons or storing them, is unsupported rather than left to DuckDB.

SELECT CAST('P9D' AS INTERVAL)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CAST to INTERVAL

SELECT SAFE_CAST('P9D' AS INTERVAL)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CAST to INTERVAL

SELECT CAST(CAST('P9D' AS STRING) AS INTERVAL)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CAST to INTERVAL

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) * 2
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $MULTIPLY with INTERVAL

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) = MAKE_INTERVAL(hour => 168)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $EQUAL with INTERVAL

SELECT NULLIF(MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7), MAKE_INTERVAL())
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function NULLIF with INTERVAL

SELECT CAST(STRUCT(MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) AS i) AS JSON)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CAST from STRUCT<i INTERVAL> to JSON

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)])
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function TO_JSON_STRING with INTERVAL

SELECT EXTRACT(WEEK FROM MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $EXTRACT

SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM MAKE_INTERVAL(month => 3))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $EXTRACT

SELECT SUM(DISTINCT i) FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support SUM(DISTINCT ...) with INTERVAL

SELECT MIN(i) FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support aggregate or analytic function MIN with INTERVAL

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) IN (SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support IN subquery with INTERVAL

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i) FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support PARTITION BY with INTERVAL

SELECT i FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i GROUP BY i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support GROUP BY with INTERVAL

SELECT DISTINCT STRUCT(i) FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support GROUP BY with INTERVAL

SELECT i FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i ORDER BY i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support ORDER BY with INTERVAL

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) UNION DISTINCT SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 8)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support set operation with INTERVAL

CREATE TEMP TABLE intervals (i ARRAY<STRUCT<v INTERVAL>>); SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support stored INTERVAL columns

CREATE TEMP TABLE intervals AS SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) AS i; SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support stored INTERVAL columns
